# LEDGER — factual run record (framework-maintained; READ-ONLY)

The objective record of every iteration: which candidate, its parent, whether the gate ACCEPTED it, the val reward + Δ, and the EXACT tasks it broke / fixed. Facts only — your own narrative, lessons, and refuted hypotheses go in JOURNAL.md. Use this to never re-introduce a change that broke a task, and to see which approaches the gate accepted vs rejected.
